coaching.headline: We lost four fights between 22.4 and 34.6 (two of them game-defining), with wins at 27.1 and 32 mixed in, then closed with a 5-1 ace at their Inhibitor at 40.2 that opened the Core a minute later.
coaching.team: The duo lane set the tone early — first blood and first Fangtooth both ours, four enemy duo deaths before ten to our one. A solo death at 20.1 cost two towers. Then two game-defining fights were lost at 22.4 and 24.4 while Murdock sat ahead in lane both times instead of joining. Fights turned from 27.1; a 5-1 ace at 40.2 took the Inhibitor and Core to close it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The two lost fights at 22.4 and 24.4 while Murdock stayed ahead in lane instead of rotating in — each one flipped from a joinable number-advantage into a clean loss, and the 24.4 loss cost the Outer Tower at 24.7 and the Fangtooth at 25.5.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane's dominance early — first blood, first Fangtooth, and four enemy deaths before ten to our one.

focus.title: A free camp nobody contested
focus.evidence: The Fangtooth at minute 16 fell to them with all five of our players alive — nobody was dead, so it wasn't a fight we lost, it was one we didn't show up to.
focus.action: Track the next Fangtooth timer and commit someone to contest it or deny vision on it before it spawns, even mid-build.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Skylar finished all six items but skipped the meta Imperator for Sky Splitter, Nuclear Rounds, and Orion instead; his lone costly death (20.1, caught out) wasn't shown to be about the build — it reads as a positioning call.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Lt. Belica. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
ourKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start
